title: Nell Finds Pip by Sound
checkpoint: Phase 5 continues (School readiness) — new sounds wh, ph
note_for_grown_ups: Phase 5 continues (School readiness), 86-sound stage (wh, ph just added).

pages.illustration: Nell the bee hovering above tall grass, looking around for Pip.

pages.text: Nell can not spot Pip in the grass.
pages.illustration: Nell the bee scanning the long grass but seeing no sign of Pip.
Nell the bee hovering still in the air, pausing to listen.
Nell the bee with her head turned, picking up a faint chirping sound.
Nell the bee flying low, heading towards the sound of chirping.
Pip the sparrow hidden among tall grass stems, chirping steadily.
Nell the bee landing beside Pip, finally spotting him in the grass.
Nell the bee and Pip the sparrow playing together among the grass stems.

pages.text: It was fun, with just a sound.
pages.illustration: Nell the bee and Pip the sparrow sitting together, both pleased with the game.

pages.text: Nell grins. She did not need to see Pip at all.
pages.illustration: Nell the bee grinning, perched happily beside Pip the sparrow.
